theorems.name: Submission.stationary_imrep_radial_tangency_of_ball_ratio
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → R.measure (closedBall (0 : Euclid P) ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall (0 : Euclid P) 1)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
